title: Phaguna and a little cold
literal_meaning: In Phaguna, the cold becomes slight.
explanation: The rhyme describes the cold easing in Phaguna. Its short, rhyming form turns a seasonal observation into an easily remembered saying. It need not describe the weather in every place or every year.
meaning_odia: ଫଗୁଣରେ ଶୀତ କମି ସାମାନ୍ୟ ହୋଇଆସିବା କଥା ଧାଡ଼ିଟି କହେ। ଛୋଟ ଧାଡ଼ିର ମିଳ ଋତୁର ଏହି ଅନୁଭବକୁ ମନେ ରଖିବା ସହଜ କରେ। ସବୁ ସ୍ଥାନ ଓ ସବୁ ବର୍ଷର ପାଣିପାଗ ଏକାପରି ହେବ ବୋଲି ଏହା କହୁନାହିଁ।
english_summary: A seasonal rhyme describes the cold easing in Phaguna.
odia_summary: ଫଗୁଣରେ ଶୀତ କମିବାର ଅନୁଭବ ଏହି ଛୋଟ ଛନ୍ଦରେ ରହିଛି।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଦୁଇଜଣ ପରପର ଥିବା ଭିନ୍ନ ଅର୍ଥ ଦେଖିଲେ। ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, ପରିଚିତ ଅର୍ଥକୁ ଆଗେ ବସାଇଦେବା ଠିକ୍ ହେବନାହିଁ। / Readers check where a quotation sits before choosing a familiar meaning. This discussion is invented.
cultural_context: Here ଦୁଗ୍ଣ carries the documented sense of slight. The line gives a seasonal impression rather than a weather rule.
